text:
maria.chen: Quick heads-up — drafting a short runbook for a possible supply-chain issue: untrusted base image provenance detected by our scanner. Need a lightweight incident play we can run with minimal disruption.

jonathan.kaplan: +1. Can you scope — build infra only or runtime images in registries too?

maria.chen: Both. Initial triage: 1) freeze new builds to staging, 2) snapshot current registries (tag+digest), 3) collect audit logs for all build/push events in the last 72h.

devops_lead: We should also rotate image signing keys and create a blocklist of digests before we do any rebuilds. If we rotate KMS keys first we might invalidate valid attestations, so order matters.

anna.k: Who owns IC for this? I can be second IC if needed. Also we need an RBAC window: restrict the build service account to read-only while we triage.

maria.chen: I'll take IC for the initial window. @devops_lead please prepare an RBAC rollback plan. Minimal checklist below — please call out missing items.

---RUNBOOK DRAFT (one-pager)---
1) Triage: mark all images pushed in last 72h as suspect.
2) Freeze: block new pushes from pipeline (flip env var: PIPELINE_PUSH=false).
3) Audit collection: pull Cloud Audit + Container Registry logs. Example queries:
```
# GCP: recent pushes
gcloud logging read "resource.type=gcr_repository AND protoPayload.methodName=\"google.devtools.containerregistry.v1.PushArtifact\"" --limit=1000 --project=redwood-prod | jq .
```
4) KMS/key actions: create new key ring for emergency rotation, generate ephemeral signing key, do not delete old keys until attestations reconciled.
5) Attestation: list existing attestations and map to digests. Revoke via Cosign if malicious.
6) RBAC: apply temporary deny to build SA (ci-runner@redwood) for push scope.
7) Communication: post status to #incidents and #eng-security.
8) Rebuild plan: prioritize minimal-surface rebuilds (critical services first).
9) Postmortem: save evidence, retain logs for 1 year.
```

jonathan.kaplan: A few comments — add a step to snapshot image manifests (skopeo inspect or gcloud container images describe) and capture the digest->tag map. Also include an offline proof list for legal.

devops_lead: For KMS: recommend staging rotation via a new key version, sign a small test image, verify CI validation fails for old signatures, then promote. Commands to inspect cosign attestations: `cosign verify-attestation --key <pubkey> <image>`

sec-ci-bot: Automated alert: vulnerability scanner flagged base-image layer ID sha256:9f4c... as containing strange origin metadata. Link: https://scanner.internal/reports/9f4c (investigate).

anna.k: RBAC delta (proposal):
- deny: storage.objects.create for ci-runner on prod-registry
- allow: storage.objects.get for read-only audit access to sec team
Apply for 30min, auto-revoke in 2h unless extended.

maria.chen: Good. Action items assigned:
- @devops_lead: prepare RBAC rollback and rotate signing key plan (ETA 30m).
- @jonathan.kaplan: snapshot registries + manifest map (ETA 20m).
- @anna.k: apply temporary deny and confirm via audit logs (ETA 10m).
- @sec-ci-bot: keep streaming scanner alerts into thread.

jonathan.kaplan: Started snapshots. small note: some manifests are shared across services — we should mark dependent services for rebuild ordering (low -> high blast).

devops_lead: Drafted KMS steps. Two cautions: if we revoke key versions, CI that validates signatures will fail; need canary path. Plan: create new key version -> publish new pubkey to keyserver -> sign canary image -> test validation -> flip acceptance policy.

anna.k: Applied RBAC deny and posted the change to audit: https://console.audit/internal/entry/xyz. CI pushes are now blocked (verified).

maria.chen: Team — please keep messages in-thread. If we escalate to Sev, we'll open an incident in #incidents and move to voice. Current status: triage in progress, registry frozen, RBAC applied, KMS rotation planned.

jonathan.kaplan: ETA for initial evidence bundle (logs + manifests) ~25m.

sec-ci-bot: New scanner finding added: additional suspicious prow job referencing external upstream. Added to evidence bundle.

maria.chen: Thanks all. I'll update the runbook and attach final checklist once we confirm attestations and rotation path. If anyone can't be reached, ping Paul or @oncall-eng. :thumbsup:

anna.k: copy. standing by.
